ci.step:
- name: "Build and axiom-guard the zeta' zero-free box probe (SpeiserDeriv*)"
        if: steps.changes.outputs.run == 'true'
        working-directory: telperion/examples/zeta_reflection/lean
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 ../arbecon/gen_speiser_box.py --check   # generator vs committed SpeiserDerivBox.lean, byte-identical
          lake build SpeiserDerivCore SpeiserDerivBox AxiomGuardSpeiserDeriv
          g=AxiomGuardSpeiserDeriv
          echo "== $g"
          rc=0; lake env lean "$g.lean" > "$g.out" 2>&1 || rc=$?
          cat "$g.out"
          if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "::error::$g: lean exited $rc"; exit 1; fi
          if grep -qE '(^|[^A-Za-z])error:' "$g.out"; then echo "::error::$g did not elaborate cleanly"; exit 1; fi
          if grep -q 'sorryAx' "$g.out"; then echo "::error::$g: a guarded theorem depends on sorry"; exit 1; fi
          joined="$(tr '\n' ' ' < "$g.out" | tr -s ' ')"
          n=$(grep -oE "depends on axioms: \[[^]]*\]|does not depend on any axioms" <<< "$joined" | wc -l)
          if [ "$n" -lt 11 ]; then echo "::error::$g printed $n axiom lines, expected at least 11"; exit 1; fi
          bad="$(grep -oE "depends on axioms: \[[^]]*\]" <<< "$joined" \
                  | sed -E 's/^depends on axioms: \[//; s/\]$//' | tr ',' '\n' | tr -d ' ' \
                  | grep -vxE 'propext|Classical\.choice|Quot\.sound' || true)"
          if [ -n "$bad" ]; then echo "::error::$g: axiom(s) outside {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}: $(echo $bad)"; exit 1; fi
          for thm in speiser_box_probe ArbEcon.Off.SpD.cell_deriv_ne_zero ArbEcon.Off.SpeiserBox.check0_neg ArbEcon.Off.SpeiserBox.check0_corrupt; do
            grep -qE "'${thm//./\\.}' (depends on axioms: \[[^]]*\]|does not depend on any axioms)" <<< "$joined" \
              || { echo "::error::$g: anchor $thm was not printed"; exit 1; }
          done
          echo "OK: speiser box guard clean (11 anchors; every axiom list within the standard three)."

not_claims: NOT the Speiser wall. Speiser (1935): zeta' zero-free on the whole open strip 0 < Re s < 1/2 is equivalent to RH. One closed box, or any finite union of boxes, decides nothing about RH.
